bullets.title: Semiconductor Sector Roars Back: SOX +5.5%, MU +13%, AMD +8%
bullets.body: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index surged 5.5% as AI chip stocks staged a powerful broad-based recovery. Micron led with gains of 12-13%, with AMD +8.11%, INTC +8.22%, MRVL +7.27%, SNDK +12.8%, and LITE +9.25% among the notable movers. Short sellers in MU described as being in 'panic' with historical FUD narratives losing effectiveness.

bullets.title: TSMC Plans 5-10% Foundry Price Hike Starting 2027
bullets.body: TSMC is reportedly planning to raise chipmaking prices by up to 10% in 2027, varying by customer and product, to offset higher materials, equipment, and overseas fab construction costs. The announcement catalyzed the semiconductor sector rally and sent SNDK +12.2%. TSMC shares fell 7.3% in Taiwan the prior day despite reporting a 77.4% jump in quarterly net income, with markets focused on open-source AI model competition risk.

bullets.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin Platform Launches: 10x Performance/Watt, Spectrum-6 Ethernet Deploying
bullets.body: NVIDIA detailed the Vera Rubin NVL72 platform claiming 10x improvement in tokens/megawatt vs. Blackwell (measured by CoreWeave on DeepSeek-R1). NVDA was also briefed to analysts on Vera CPU, which uses monolithic architecture for agentic workloads rather than chiplet design, positioning against AMD Turin. Spectrum-6 (102.4 Tbps Ethernet switch) is now arriving at AI factories including CoreWeave, Microsoft, Nebius, SpaceX, and Tesla.

bullets.title: NVDA Vera Rubin: Report of 1,000 Racks/Day (~$630B Quarterly Run Rate)
bullets.body: The Information reports NVIDIA could manufacture 1,000 Vera Rubin racks per day, implying a ~$630B quarterly revenue run rate. One credible fintwit voice expressed skepticism about the math but noted the bull case remains credible, warning that using NVDA as a 'safe funding short' carries significant risk. NVIDIA also confirmed Vera Rubin is on track with customer testing underway and claims speed advantage over AMD Turin.

bullets.title: AMD Wins Azure Helios Deal; AMD-Anthropic Partnership Expected to Exceed OAI/Meta
bullets.body: AMD secured the Azure Helios AI rack deal with Microsoft, marking the first real test of NVIDIA's data center rack monopoly. Separately, GFHK now expects AMD's Anthropic deal to be larger than the OpenAI and Meta deals. One analyst raised AMD's TP to $640 (45x 2027E EPS, revised up 11%) and expects Anthropic to be unveiled as AMD's third GW-level customer. AMD's Helios rack is reportedly priced 40% above NVIDIA's second-gen Rubin.

bullets.title: AMD MI500X ISA Released; MI455X Copying NVIDIA Hopper TMA Architecture
bullets.body: AMD released the MI500X ISA with 1 TDM MOE descriptor shared across all experts. The MI455X is adding TDM (RMA) modeled after NVIDIA's SM90 Hopper ISA TMA. A fintwit semiconductor analyst framed AMD and INTC CPU demand as being underestimated by the market, with AMD's Advancing AI event and INTC earnings expected to reinforce this theme.

bullets.title: Intel EMIB Packaging May Be Bigger AI Opportunity Than 18A Process
bullets.body: Analyst argues Intel's EMIB advanced packaging technology could be a larger AI opportunity than its 18A process node, potentially shifting AI inference dynamics vs. TSM's CoWoS. Intel is also reportedly planning layoffs within its data center group, though the scale remains unclear.

bullets.title: NVDA Stakes Nebius, Hut 8, IREN in Multibillion-Dollar AI Cloud Deals
bullets.body: NVIDIA secured multibillion-dollar AI cloud commitments with Nebius, Hut 8, and IREN. One analyst noted IREN currently has more announced projects under review than NBIS for now. NBIS separately acknowledged its hyperscaler compute business is a stop-gap model, targeting 50%+ of 2026 ARR from enterprises and AI labs.

bullets.title: Apple Launches 'Upgrade' Klarna-Backed Leasing Program July 28
bullets.body: Apple is partnering with Klarna to launch 'Apple Upgrade,' a subscription-based device leasing program launching July 28 in the US. The program covers most iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Apple Watch models, with options to pay off, upgrade early, or keep devices. The move is seen as targeting acceleration of the upgrade cycle. AAPL currently trades at 40x P/E vs. 26x 10-year average.

bullets.title: Google Launches Gemini 3.6 Flash, Begins Pre-Training Gemini 4
bullets.body: Google launched three new Gemini models: Gemini 3.6 Flash ($1.50/$7.50 per million input/output tokens), Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite ($0.30/$2.50), and Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber. Google also began pre-training for Gemini 4 and is testing Gemini 3.5 Pro with partners ahead of wider release.

bullets.title: TSLA -15% YTD, Cybertruck Misses Target; Robotaxi Expands to Florida
bullets.body: TSLA is down 15% YTD, underperforming GM (-2%) and F (+9%) as management continues a pattern of overpromising on autonomy. Tesla also missed its 18-month deadline for 240,000 annual Cybertruck sales. On the positive side, Tesla expanded its robotaxi service to Orlando (unsupervised Model Y rides), Tampa, and broader Florida, now live in 7 areas. One analyst estimates 2Q adj EPS at $0.60 vs. $0.55 WS consensus.

bullets.title: Microsoft Using Kimi K3 for Copilot; Mistral Partnership Expanded
bullets.body: Microsoft is reportedly deploying Moonshot's Kimi K3 to power its flagship Copilot AI assistant, potentially cutting token costs by 60%. Separately, Microsoft announced an expanded multibillion-dollar partnership with Mistral AI, integrating Mistral models across Azure Foundry, Copilot Studio, and Azure with added GPU capacity in Europe.

bullets.title: NBIS: Bullish Flow and Hyperscaler-to-Enterprise Revenue Shift
bullets.body: MU showed the most bullish options flow of the session per unusual flow trackers. NBIS separately detailed its strategy: hyperscaler compute is acknowledged as a stop-gap, with 50%+ of 2026 ARR targeted from enterprises and AI labs as non-hyperscaler long-term customers are prioritized.

bullets.title: Polymarket: 63-64% Odds of Fed Rate Hike in 2026; Futures Price 1.5 Hikes
bullets.body: Polymarket traders now price a 63-64% probability of a Fed rate hike in 2026, up sharply from 10% in March. Rate futures are simultaneously pricing 1.5 rate hikes by year-end. US 10-year and 30-year yields hit two-month highs. Brent crude neared $92/bbl on Middle East escalation, fueling sticky inflation concerns.

bullets.title: Oil Hits Five-Week High Above $91 on Red Sea/Hormuz Disruptions; Goldman Warns $120
bullets.body: Brent crude climbed above $91/bbl (+2%) as the US-Iran conflict escalated, Saudi crude tankers reversed course in the Red Sea, and Houthis declared a naval blockade on Saudi Arabia. Hormuz commercial traffic fell to a three-week low with threat level maintained at 'Severe.' Goldman warns Brent could top $120 if the Gulf chokepoint crisis deepens. Rare earth waivers also expire in November with potential $6.5T GDP cost.

bullets.title: S&P 500 Within 1.5% of All-Time Highs; UBS Raises 2026 Target to 8,100
bullets.body: The S&P 500 gained 0.7-2% as AI and chip stocks rebounded despite macro headwinds; SPY is now less than $10 and 1.5% below prior all-time highs. UBS raised its 2026 S&P 500 year-end target to 8,100, implying 8.8% upside. SPX gamma resistance is heaviest at 7,520-7,530 per options analysis.

bullets.title: AI Capex: FCF Collapsing, Hyperscaler Energy Costs Set to Double by 2029
bullets.body: Hyperscaler AI capex is transitioning from FCF-funded to issuance-based, making Q2 earnings guidance a bond market event. Forward FCF estimates have collapsed due to record AI capex with uncertain payoff timelines. Separately, energy is forecast to rise from ~10% to 20-30% of hyperscaler compute costs by 2029, driven by natural gas-fueled generation pricing. SemiAnalysis models show existing US grid headroom exhausted by 2027/28.

bullets.title: HOOD: Needham Raises PT to $123; StockTwits Founder Early Backer
bullets.body: Needham raised Robinhood's price target to $123, citing continued strength across equities, options, prediction markets, and crypto, positioning HOOD as a leading contender to become a financial super app. HOOD was also up 8%+ on the session. StockTwits founder Howard Lindzon is noted as an early investor who backed Robinhood at an $8M valuation.

bullets.title: July Russell 1000 Momentum Unwind: Top H1 Performers Down 25% on Average
bullets.body: The 25 best-performing Russell 1,000 stocks in H1 2026 have declined an average of 25.4% in July, with all 25 down at least 8% MTD. The technology sector entered today 4% below its 50-DMA (the farthest of any sector) while Financials trade 5.3% above their 50-DMA. Despite 'bubble' narratives, only 2 trading days all year have seen tech as the year's best-performing sector on a YTD basis.

bullets.title: AMZN: Iran Claims IRGC Launched Missiles at Amazon Data Infrastructure in Bahrain
bullets.body: Iran's IRGC claimed it launched cruise missiles at Amazon data infrastructure in Bahrain, per CNBC. The claim has not been independently verified. Amazon's B2B e-commerce site separately is approaching $60B in annual sales. Former senior AWS employee also noted AWS Bedrock carries higher margins than SageMaker.
